data.one_liner: Logger for Dart and Flutter applications using mixins for separation
data.what_it_does: Loggy provides a customizable logging framework for Dart and Flutter apps. It leverages class mixins to automatically capture and display the calling class context, while supporting custom printers, filters, log levels, and global logging.
use_when: You want structured console logs showing which class or mixin made the log call
You need custom log formatting, printers, and filtering based on log types or levels
avoid_when: You only require a basic, zero-config print wrapper without mixins or custom printers
You are looking for a remote crash-reporting service rather than a console/stream logger
strengths: Uses mixins to automatically identify the calling class and logger type
Highly customizable with different printers, log levels, and filters
Supports global logging and child/detached loggers
weaknesses: Requires classes to use specific mixins for full class-name context tracking
Relies on additional sub-packages for specific Flutter or Dio integrations
data.setup_notes: Call Loggy.initLoggy() in main() as soon as possible before running the app.

alternatives.name: logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a standard logger without mixins or specialized log types.

alternatives.name: talker
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a more comprehensive logging and error handling solution with an in-app UI.
